summary_en: 200,000 shares (0.62% S/O), ¥100.0M upper limit, open-market purchase, 15 Jun–31 Jul 2026. Rationale: support 15% ROE target under TCG Future Vision 2030 mid-term plan (2026–2030) through flexible capital and equity-efficiency initiatives.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 10 June 2026, Tanabe Consulting Group's board resolved to acquire up to 200,000 treasury shares (0.62% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) within a maximum outlay of ¥100.0 million. Acquisition will occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 15 June and 31 July 2026. The programme supports execution of flexible capital and equity-efficiency initiatives in pursuit of the company's 15% ROE target articulated in the TCG Future Vision 2030 mid-term plan (2026–2030). As of 31 March 2026, the company held 1,890,256 treasury shares against 32,109,744 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
